messages.subject: Redwood — retention point landed
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Whitlock has accepted the retention at £100k with a 30 Sep longstop — better than nothing and the client gets the post-completion uplift via 13.2 regardless. Net initial yield still stacks at 6.40%. I think we're clear to recommend exchange once AML on the SPV directors is signed off. Elena's lease review threw up nothing further.

James
